summary.overview: HDFC ERGO Optima Secure is a comprehensive health insurance plan offering high sum insured options up to Rs. 2 crores with generous pre and post-hospitalization coverage. It features in-built protections like automatic restoration and strong base coverages with 'At Actuals' room rent limits.
best_for: Individuals looking for high sum insured health covers
Families seeking comprehensive floater benefits without room rent restrictions
Buyers wanting extensive pre and post-hospitalization durations
watch_outs: Maternity expenses are excluded under standard coverage
36-month waiting period applies for pre-existing diseases
Specific surgical procedures and illnesses carry a 24-month waiting period
next_actions: Review the specific plan variant (e.g., Optima Secure vs Lite/Select) to align with room rent preferences
Declare all pre-existing medical conditions transparently during the proposal stage
Note the claim intimation timelines of 24 hours for emergencies and 48 hours for planned admissions

risks.title: Pre-existing diseases covered only after 3 years
risks.explanation: Any illness you had before buying the policy is not covered until this period of continuous cover is complete.
risks.quote: until the expiry of 36 months (Unless specified otherwise in the Policy Schedule) of continuous coverage

risks.title: 2 years wait for listed diseases/procedures
risks.explanation: Treatments on the specific list (e.g. Cataract, Non infective Arthritis, Pilonidal sinus, Diseases of gall bladder including cholecystitis) are not covered in this period.
risks.quote: until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy with us.

risks.title: Emergency admission must be reported within 24 hours
risks.explanation: Late intimation can delay or complicate the claim.
risks.quote: Within 24 hours from the date of emergency Hospitalization required or before the Insured Person’s discharge from Hospital, whichever is earlier.

risks.title: Exclusion of maternity treatments
risks.explanation: Childbirth and related medical expenses are entirely excluded from the base policy coverage except for ectopic pregnancies.
risks.quote: Medical treatment expenses traceable to childbirth (including complicated deliveries and caesarean sections incurred during hospitalization) except ectopic pregnancy
